summary: Carlton County, MN tower, 80-ft Aermotor erected 1931 and owned by UMN; 2018 fence and stair-safety review; FFLA lists it standing; no staffing record found.

access.note: The forest is open to the public in daylight, but the recreation page does not mention the tower. A 2018 report says the fence door was unlocked for visitor access while the stairs and railings were under safety review. No current tower policy found.

visit.trail_note: Forest roads and trails are open to on-trail, non-motorized recreation during daylight; off-trail recreation is prohibited

notes_for_editor: Built date 1931, 80 ft and Aermotor design rest on one local history page (Forest Lookouts). No manufacturer source was read; a Peakbagger entry (1931, 80 ft, standing, user-submitted and unverified) and search snippets were not quoted. Results of the 2018 Collaborative Design Group assessment were not found. The Forest History Center tower in Grand Rapids is a different structure and was not used. Access is set to restricted as a judgment: the forest is open in daylight, the recreation page does not mention the tower, and the 2018 door was unlocked for visitors, but the stairs and railings were under safety review. No current tower policy found. Staffing is unknown; the Forest Lookouts page gives no staff names.
